# AI Ethics Workshop

> A comprehensive research and educational platform exploring the philosophical, ethical, and practical dimensions of AI governance, fairness, and data ethics.

Hosted at Goethe University, the AI Ethics Workshop provides course materials, definitions, principles frameworks, and multimedia content for understanding AI ethics. The site connects academic research with real-world applications in privacy, surveillance, insurance, and algorithmic fairness.

## Key Topics

- AI ethics
- privacy
- fairness
- data ethics
- explainability
- AI governance
- big data
- autonomy
- dignity
- surveillance
- identity
- insurance
- philosophy
- algorithmic bias
- policy recommendations

## Core & Overview

- [AI Ethics Workshop](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org): Homepage for AI ethics research workshop at Goethe University

## Educational Materials

- [Course Materials](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org/course-materials): Course materials on philosophical ethics principles for AI governance
- [Videos & Publications](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org/videos-publications): Workshop videos and publications on AI ethics and fairness topics

## Frameworks & Reference

- [AI Ethics Principles](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org/principles): AI ethics principles framework and policy recommendations
- [Definitions & Concepts](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org/definitions-concepts): Definitions and concepts in data ethics, privacy, and surveillance

## Creative & Cultural Perspectives

- [Art & Culture](https://ai.ethicsworkshop.org/art-culture): Art and culture projects exploring AI ethics, privacy, and biometrics
